summary: Frontend-only regression on /farpapainel rename. All 5 requested checks PASS: (1) /farpapainel and /farpapainel/ no longer redirect to /farpainel — URL keeps /farpapainel and loads HashRouter #/login with title 'Painel PM SP'. (2) Login screen shows brand 'PM SP' + subtitle 'PAINEL ADMINISTRATIVO' + avatar 'P'. No 'Sedes' or 'DF' present in body. (3) Login with farpa/Ads102030 succeeds and navigates to /farpapainel/#/dashboard. h1='Dashboard - PM SP', sidebar shows 'PM SP / PAINEL', user badge 'farpa (root)', avatar 'P'. Zero 'Sedes' references on page. (4) Legacy /farpainel/ still serves same PM SP app (no Sedes). (5) POST /api/admin/auth/login returns 200 with valid JWT token.
critical_code_review_comments: Login inputs USUÁRIO/SENHA lack placeholder and name attributes — only distinguishable by input index/type. Adding data-testid='login-username' / 'login-password' would improve testability.
Cloudflare beacon (static.cloudflareinsights.com) still triggers CORS errors in console — cosmetic only, no functional impact.
